title: Work Order Process Summary: Functionality

children:
Work Order processing manages the creation of finished items from component 
 parts. All work order related information, such as components and instructions, 
 can be stored on a bill of material record or manually entered when the 
 work order is created. Component part allocation can be performed automatically when the work 
 order is created or released. Employees can also manually allocate components. You can use work creation to support the movement of component parts 
 to the build location and finished items to their storage locations. You 
 can also choose not to use work creation and instead use paperwork to 
 move items. Also, the system supports bill of material revision numbers. When you copy 
 an existing bill of material record, the system assigns the new record 
 a revision number. This allows you to support multiple versions of one 
 finished item.
Using the Work Order Insight Screen
Using the Work Order Line Insight Screen
Using the Work Order License Plate Screen
The following are key features of the work order functional area:

The system allows you to manage component part allocation based on your 
 warehouse needs. You can set component parts to be allocated as soon as 
 the work order is created. This is helpful if you need to reserve component 
 parts in advance. If you prefer to allocate components after the work 
 order is ready to be processed, you can set to allocate the components 
 when the work order is released. Finally, you can choose to allocate component 
 parts manually at some point after the work order is created.

The system supports the breakdown of finished items after they are constructed. 
 This allows you to deassemble a finished item and introduce its component 
 parts back as inventory. Inventory management moves the build components 
 back to the build location, where you can either use them or transfer 
 them back to their original storage locations.

Work order documents can be printed manually from the Work Order 
 Insight screen, or automatically during the work creation process. Below is a list 
 of the documents available:

Work Order Pick List - This 
 document identifies the component parts needed, their storage locations 
 and the build location that they need to be delivered to. You can set 
 the system to print this document as soon as the work order is released 
 or you can print them when the components are allocated.

Work Order Instruction List 
 - This document identifies the component parts needed and the instructions 
 on how to assemble them. You can set the system to print this document 
 as soon as the work order is released or you can print them when the components 
 are allocated.

Work Order Finished 
 Item Putaway List - This document provides putaway information 
 for the finished item, including its putaway location. You can set the 
 system to print this document as soon as the finished item is confirmed 
 or you can print them manually later.

You can use these documents to manage the movement and assembly of components 
 to the build location and the putaway of the finished item. These documents 
 can be used with work creation, or in place of work creation.
The system support the interfacing of work orders and bills of materials into the system.
